provenance.observed_pattern: Multiple CTEs mark gaps with LAG, assign contiguous groups with a cumulative window, aggregate ordered labels, and retain only groups whose label sequence repeats as a complete cycle before joining descriptive metadata.
provenance.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthor the sequence analysis for member practice topics with independently designed tables, dates, labels, and thresholds; retain standard DATEDIFF, LAG, cumulative SUM, GROUP_CONCAT, SUBSTRING_INDEX, REPEAT, HAVING, and final metadata join semantics.

fixture_notes: One member has six consecutive practice entries forming a three-topic cycle; a second member has six entries with a broken final topic and must be excluded.
determinism_notes: Practice entry IDs and dates are unique per member; every window, ordered concatenation, grouped result, and final report has explicit deterministic ordering.
setup: CREATE TABLE member_profiles (member_id INT PRIMARY KEY, display_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, track VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE practice_log (entry_id INT PRIMARY KEY, member_id INT NOT NULL, practiced_on DATE NOT NULL, topic VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, minutes_spent DECIMAL(6,1) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH entry_gaps AS (SELECT entry_id, member_id, practiced_on, topic, minutes_spent, DATEDIFF(practiced_on, LAG(practiced_on) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY practiced_on, entry_id)) AS day_gap FROM practice_log), entry_groups AS (SELECT entry_id, member_id, practiced_on, topic, minutes_spent, SUM(CASE WHEN day_gap IS NULL OR day_gap > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY practiced_on, entry_id) AS group_id FROM entry_gaps), repeating_tracks AS (SELECT g.member_id, g.group_id, GROUP_CONCAT(g.topic ORDER BY g.practiced_on, g.entry_id SEPARATOR '|') AS topic_sequence, COUNT(*) AS total_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT g.topic) AS cycle_size, ROUND(SUM(g.minutes_spent), 1) AS total_minutes FROM entry_groups g GROUP BY g.member_id, g.group_id HAVING total_entries >= 6 AND cycle_size >= 3 AND total_entries % cycle_size = 0 AND REPEAT(CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(topic_sequence, '|', cycle_size), '|'), total_entries / cycle_size) = CONCAT(topic_sequence, '|')) SELECT r.member_id, p.display_name, p.track, r.cycle_size, r.total_minutes FROM repeating_tracks r INNER JOIN member_profiles p ON r.member_id = p.member_id ORDER BY r.cycle_size DESC, r.total_minutes DESC, r.member_id
